csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking professional consulting services to prepare complete design and engineering plans for the 9th Street & Bodenhamer Park Development Project. The selected consultant will provide all necessary professional services required to advance the project from initial site evaluation through preparation of construction-ready bid documents. Scope of work is anticipated to include but is not limited to: topographic and boundary surveying; limited geotechnical investigation (due to large storm drain under the site); site analysis; conceptual and final park design; and preparation of detailed construction documents. Design elements shall address grading and drainage, stormwater management, utilities, irrigation, lighting, pedestrian circulation, and compliance with applicable accessibility (ADA) requirements. The proposed park improvements are expected to include a combination of active and passive recreation areas, landscaping, and site amenities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater
